sara (sec-eng): Noticed several tenants in APAC with stalled SCIM deprovisions after last night's secret rotation. RBAC deltas not reflected. Anyone oncall?

tom (infra): on it. which hosts/region? any error snippets?

sara (sec-eng): ap-southeast-1. provisioner logs show KMS:decrypt/key_missing and repeated retries. Example: 
2026-03-20T01:04:11Z provisioner[pid=223]: ERROR apply-role tenant=gamma user=carol err=KMS:decrypt error="key alias not found" corr=tx-44f3

riley (sre): that usually means the agent has alias mismatch or missing key id env. can you check /etc/rdw/kms_alias and REDWOOD_KMS_KEY_ID on hosts?

tom (infra): running quick checks now.

vault-bot: Vault replication status: ap-southeast-1 shard lagging, last sync 2026-03-19T23:58:02Z, pending replicas=2/4.

tom (infra): confirmed on host ap-southeast-1a: /etc/rdw/kms_alias contains alias/rdw/provisioner/2026-03-19 but /etc/rdw/kms_key_id is empty. bootstrap log shows secret-inject failure from vault replication timeouts.

sara (sec-eng): that explains missing audit entries too (role.grant/role.revoke metrics dropped). securitybot, any alerts?

securitybot: Alert: audit.events.role_ops.ingest_drop at 2026-03-20T01:10:00Z. drop_count=32 in 5m window.

riley (sre): remediation plan: (1) do not rotate any further aliases until replication healthy, (2) force-inject kms_key_id from primary into affected hosts as emergency patch, (3) restart provisioner to drain queues and replay. Collect logs/evidence before and after restart.

tom (infra): applying emergency patch to 1a and 1b now, capturing /var/log/provisioner and bootstrap logs, and /etc/rdw/* files. Will upload sanitized bundle to /shared/sec-incidents/1825559999/.

sara (sec-eng): also add a short checklist for postmortem: ensure bootstrap fails fast if critical secret missing, add rollout pre-check for vault replication state, and alert when REDWOOD_KMS_KEY_ID unset.

riley (sre): monitoring shows audit ingest returning to baseline ~45s after restart. queues drained. assigning runbook updates: @tom infra, @sara sec-eng, @riley sre.

sara (sec-eng): thanks. Ill notify impacted account teams and begin audit backfill using correlation ids in the evidence bundle. Reopen thread if anything regresses.

securitybot: Incident logged INC-20260320-9001 severity=medium status=mitigated
